expected_outcome.description: A report that walks the whole chain in order, each hop with its path and line: the route handler (`src/routes/orders.ts:7`, after `requireAuth` at `src/http/auth.ts:1`), `createOrder` (`src/services/orders.ts:4`), `priceItems` (`src/services/pricing.ts:1`), `insertOrder` (`src/repo/orders.ts:3`) and the `db.execute` INSERT (`src/repo/orders.ts:4`), with `db` created in `src/db.ts:3`. The order of hops must be right, and it must not skip the service layer.
